title: BirdCLEF 2026 soft pseudo-labels (train_soundscapes)
subtitle: Soft teacher targets on the 10,592 unlabeled train_soundscapes for noisy-student
description:
SOFT pseudo-labels for noisy-student self-distillation (BirdCLEF+ 2026, T2-A).

Produced by a CPU-only Kaggle utility kernel (pseudo_label_precompute/precompute_pseudo_labels.py) that runs the best PUBLIC inference-only ensemble over the unlabeled train_soundscapes:
  * Perch v2 ONNX branch  (tuckerarrants/perch-v2-no-dft-onnx) — 234-class species head + 1536-D embedding.
  * Distilled-SED ONNX    (tuckerarrants/bc2026-distilled-sed-public) — AttBlockV2 SED, clip+frame logits.

BLEND: 0.950 public anchor's dominant branch — z = 0.60*R(p_perch) + 0.40*R(p_sed), R = class-wise percentile rank (rank-blend).
SOFT-LABEL RULE (2025 5th-place / Nikita 1st-place, verified): power_transform(p) = clamp(p*(p>0.3) + p**2, 0, 1). These are the post-power-transform SOFT probabilities. The downstream hard-label MIXING (alpha=0.7: label = 0.7*soft + 0.3*hard) is applied in the TRAINING loop, NOT baked into this artifact.

FILES:
  - pseudo_soft_per_window.parquet : columns filename, start_sec, window_idx, row_id, win_confidence, then 234 soft species scores. 12 windows (5 s each) per file.
  - pseudo_soft_per_window.npz     : compact mirror (soft[N,234], filename, start_sec, window_idx, classes).
  - pseudo_soft_per_file.parquet   : per-file aggregate (max over windows) with a file_confidence column + 234 scores.
  - manifest.json                  : full schema + blend/transform/alpha consumption contract.

See pseudo_label_precompute/README.md in the source repo for the noisy-student consumption contract.
